tool.name: record_phase
tool.description:
Declare a scan-phase boundary so consumers can render meaningful progress.
Phases are the macro stages of a structured scan: recon → exploit → validate → report. Calling this tool emits a `phase.entered` (or `phase.completed`) event into the run's events.jsonl stream. Webappsec, the TUI, and any other consumer can use these to render progress bars, gate downstream operations, or run end-of-phase coverage validators.
Cheap — each call emits one event. Use it to bookend phases, especially when the agent is about to switch focus (recon → exploit), or when a phase wraps up early.
Action semantics: - action='enter' (default): records phase start, returns a phase_id. - action='complete': closes the phase. Pass the phase_id from the earlier enter call.
If `complete` is never called, strix's run-completion path closes any still-open phases automatically — so fire-and-forget is fine for short scans.
Custom phase names (anything not in {recon, exploit, validate, report}) are accepted but flagged in the event payload as custom.

parameter.name: phase
parameter.description: One of recon, exploit, validate, report. Custom phase names accepted but tagged as custom in the event.

parameter.name: action
parameter.description: Either "enter" (default) or "complete". When "complete", phase_id from the earlier enter call must be passed.

parameter.name: phase_id
parameter.description: Required only when action='complete'. The phase_id returned by the earlier enter call.

parameter.name: focus
parameter.description: Optional sub-focus for this phase (e.g. "dns_security" during a recon-only domain scan). Surfaces in the event payload for downstream filtering.
